meta.title: Receptio – receptionist vocale AI
meta.description: Receptio è un receptionist vocale AI per le piccole imprese. Risponde al telefono, fissa appuntamenti e nulla va perso.

hero.title: Il tuo receptionist non dorme mai
hero.subtitle: Un assistente AI risponde a ogni chiamata, risponde alle domande e prende messaggi, anche alle 2 di notte.
hero.suitable: Ideale per ristoranti, studi dentistici, officine e parrucchieri
hero.trial: 14 giorni gratis, senza carta di credito

how.title: Come funziona
how.step1Text: Descrivi la tua attività, gli orari di apertura e le domande più frequenti dei clienti.
how.step2Text: Ricevi un numero di telefono locale o inoltra le chiamate dal tuo numero attuale.
how.step3Text: Ogni chiamata viene registrata e il riepilogo arriva via email o SMS.

roi.title: Quanto ti costa una chiamata persa?
roi.conversion: Tasso di conversione di una chiamata persa
roi.cta: Inizia a salvare le tue chiamate →
roi.note: Stima: chiamate perse × 4 settimane × valore cliente × tasso di conversione.

demo.title: This is how Receptio talks to a customer
demo.subtitle: An illustrative conversation: a customer calls a restaurant on Sunday at 9 PM.
demo.note: Illustrative example, not a recording of a real call. Real calls appear as transcripts in your dashboard.
demo.c1: Good evening, could I book a table for 4 tomorrow?
demo.a1: Good evening! We would love to have you. What time would you like to come, and do you prefer the terrace or the indoor area?
demo.a2: Great, terrace for 4 at 7 PM – noted. What name should I put the reservation under?

security.title: We treat your data responsibly
security.i1Text: The database runs on servers in the European Union. We do not pass data to third parties for their own purposes.
security.i2Text: All communication with the app uses an encrypted connection (HTTPS/TLS). Only you and your team can see call recordings.
security.i3Text: You can delete an agent together with its entire call history and release phone numbers right in the app.

callBehavior.maxDurationHint: The call ends automatically when the limit is reached. With no limit, a call ends after 12 hours at the latest.
callBehavior.disclosure: Tell callers about AI and recording

callBehavior.disclosureOff: Warning: if you turn this off, you are responsible for informing callers about the AI and the recording as required by law (GDPR, call recording regulations).
